Samira K.: hey folks — first week here! trying to finish observability setup. few quick things i hit: 1) Datadog API key guidance for local dev vs k8s secrets? 2) can't find our service dashboards in Grafana beyond the main Platform Overview folder 11 3) Sentry says "no org access" after SSO. who's the right ping for each so i don't spam everyone?

/devex-bot: Welcome Samira! Please see https://go.redwood/onboard-checklist and file the access form for observability. DevEx will assist within the day. :wave:

Jules (DevEx): welcome! short answers: Datadog -> keep per-user API keys in 1Password at redwood/integrations/datadog/dev. For local dev export DD_API_KEY; for k8s create a secret and reference it in helm values. Grafana -> folders are gated by SSO group; i'll add you to the engineers group and share the team folder. Sentry -> inv to your work email should be pending; i'll re-send.

Jules (DevEx): k8s snippet: 
```bash
kubectl create secret generic datadog-api --from-literal=api-key=$DD_API_KEY -n my-dev-namespace
# helm values
datadog:
  apiKeyExistingSecret: datadog-api
```
Set DD_ENV=dev to separate ingested telemetry.

Ravi (Platform): FYI Grafana access is controlled via SSO groups mapped to folders. i added you to group `engineers` and shared folder `team/redwood-search`. if it still doesn't show, log out/in to force SSO sync or ping @eng-infra. direct link: https://grafana.redwood/team/redwood-search

Maya (Observability): resent Sentry invite to samira@redwood.com; check spam/promotions. we also have a read-only Starter dashboard set called "Starter: Observability" — ping me which dashboard you'd like edit access for. for alerts, tag `team:oncall-search` or it defaults to platform oncall.

Samira K.: thanks — quick follow-up about costs. if i run the datadog agent locally and send traces/metrics, does that count toward org ingestion/billing? any tips to avoid spamming prod?

Jules (DevEx): yes traces/metrics count. best practice: use DD_ENV=dev, set low sample rates, or run the agent in local-only mode for UI checks. example: 
```bash
# run agent without cloud upload for exploration
docker run --rm -e DD_API_KEY=$DD_API_KEY -e DD_ENV=dev -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock datadog/agent:latest agent run --no-cloud-upload
```
Also use tracing sampling config in ddtrace to drop most spans during local dev.

Ravi (Platform): we have quota safeguards in the dev org but still avoid high-volume uploads. thanks for checking.

Samira K.: i can see the Grafana folder now and the Sentry invite came through. Datadog secret created using the kubectl snippet. setting sampling low. really appreciate the speedy help :raised_hands:

Maya (Observability): great! i'll DM you a tiny checklist with direct links to the most useful dashboards, a saved search for errors, and the onboarding alert playbook.

Samira K.: perfect 1 closing this thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
